title: Distinct computation cores before halting
statement: Let $M$ be a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean symbols, let $c$ be a configuration on input $x$, and let $T$ be a natural number. Suppose the computation from $c$ is halted at time $T$ and is not halted at any time $t<T$. Then for any $t_1<t_2<T$, the cores of the configurations at times $t_1$ and $t_2$ are distinct.
hypotheses_covered: A machine with $k$ work tapes, Boolean symbols, and state set $S$
The state at time $T$ is absent
At every time $t<T$, the state is present
